ja404:1.1: Yattha verī nivasati na vase tattha paṇḍito, (Jāt.I. p..) ekarattaṃ dirattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vasati verisu.
ja404:2.1: Diso ve lahucitt' assa posassa anuvidhiyyato ekassa kapino hetu yūthassa anayo kato.
ja404:3.1: Bālo ca paṇḍitamānī yūthassa parihārako sacittassa vasaṃ gantvā sayethāyaṃ yathā kapi.
ja404:4.1: Na sādhu balavā bālo yūthassa parihārako, ahito bhavati ñātīnaṃ sakuṇānaṃ va cetako.
ja404:5.1: Dhīro ca balavā sādhu yūthassa parihārako hito bhavati ñātīnaṃ Tidasānaṃ va Vāsavo.
ja404:6.1: Yo ca sīlañ ca paññañ ca sutañ c' attani passati ubhinnam atthaṃ carati attano ca parassa ca.
ja404:7.1: Tasmā tuleyya-m-attānaṃ sīlapaññāsutām iva gaṇaṃ vā parihare dhīro eko vāpi paribbaje ti.
